import java.util.Scanner;

public class B646 {
	public static void main(String[] args) {
		// TODO Auto-generated method stub
		Scanner obj=new Scanner(System.in);
		int t=obj.nextInt();
		while(t-->0)
		{
			int n=obj.nextInt();
			int x=obj.nextInt();
			long sum=0;
			int[] arr=new int[n];
			for(int i=0;i<n;i++)
			{
				arr[i]=obj.nextInt();
			}
			int c=0,o=0,e=0;
			boolean flag=false;
			for(int i=0;i<n;i++)
			{
				sum+=arr[i];
				if(arr[i]%2!=0)
					o++;
				else
					e++;	
			}
			
			if(o==0)
			{
				System.out.println("No");
				continue;
			}
			if(e==0)
			{
				if(x%2==0)
					System.out.println("No");
				else 
					System.out.println("Yes");
				continue;
			}
			 if(x==n)
			{
				if(o%2!=0)
					System.out.println("Yes");
				else
					System.out.println("No");
				continue;
			}
			System.out.println("Yes");
		}


	}
}
